c.h: Simplified from the 言 component in the traditional character 這, which is based on archaic pronunciation yàn.

這.o: Phonosemantic compound. 辶 represents the meaning and 言 represents the sound. The character originally meant "to meet" and had a pronunciation corresponding to modern Mandarin yàn. 這 later acquired an unrelated pronunciation and meaning through confusion with 遮.
